free_tier.stated: No total storage quota stated; uploader accepts an unbounded number of files. Live uploader JS caps a single file at 155 GiB (constant MAXB = 155*1024*1024*1024, error string 'files over 150 GB are not allowed').

retention.stated: Files stay online as long as they're being accessed. Only files untouched for 45+ days are ever deleted — and only when we need the space. A broad extension blocklist (php, html, js, exe, dll, apk, sh, py, xml, svg and script types) was recorded previously but is not stated on the page read.

egress.terms: Unmetered direct download links, no bandwidth product at all. No paid tier is sold, so there is no egress meter to trip.

record.tooling: chunked.php REST protocol, fully scriptable and keyless: POST ?action=init&filename=&size= -> {id, chunk_size}, POST ?action=chunk&id=&i= with raw body, POST ?action=finish&id= -> {url}. 128 MiB chunks, PARALLEL=6 in the shipped client.
record.chaining: Account-less upload breaks the per-account quota model entirely: every file is independent, so chain = unlimited files x 155 GiB. Only per-IP rate limits and the retention clock bind.
record.limits_note: 155 GiB / 150 GB per file (live JS constant). 128 MiB chunks, 6 parallel. Extension blocklist is broad (php, html, js, exe, dll, apk, sh, py, xml, svg, iso-adjacent script types). .bin/.parquet/.npy/.zip/.7z are fine. Retention: indefinite while accessed; only 45+ day untouched files are reclaim candidates.
record.reliability_note: Upload path works headlessly today; download path is Cloudflare-Turnstile gated (403 cf-mitigated: challenge on the itsfileditchfiles.st host even with Range + browser UA), so a non-browser client can write but not read.
